text: actively marketed The symbol  denotes a substance whose use may be restricted in certain sports (see p.vii) Similar warnings have been issued in other countries, but some cases have continued to be reported.12 In the USA the FDA has required a warning to be added to prescribing information for the fluoroquinolones stating that there is an increased risk in patients over 60, in kidney, heart, and lung transplant recipients, and with use of concomitant corticosteroid therapy.13 There have been reports14,15 of rhabdomyolysis in patients given fluoroquinolones, including one fatality associated with levo- floxacin therapy.14 1.
